nodes.title: The Liberation Line
nodes.description: Reunification by force will demand a costly concentration of military power and the abandonment of a negotiated settlement.

nodes.title: Forward Artillery
nodes.description: Forward batteries can strike southern defensive positions, but their deployment and ammunition stocks will be difficult to conceal.

nodes.title: Forward Supply Depots

nodes.title: General Mobilization

nodes.title: A Southern Command

starting_spirits.title: The Monolithic Ideological System
starting_spirits.description: The purges have secured the Leader’s command while suppressing independent reporting and technical disagreement.
starting_spirits.remedy: Replaced by Monolithic Leadership or Collective Deliberation. Earned WPK policies apply while the WPK governs and return with that government.

starting_spirits.title: Economic and Defence Construction
starting_spirits.description: The parallel build-up strengthens deterrence while defence absorbs labour, capital and public expenditure.
starting_spirits.remedy: Army reorganization reduces this to a residual +4% core defence / -4% civilian construction burden; final national arsenal/civilian conversion choice replaces the residual.

starting_spirits.title: The Extended Seven-Year Plan
starting_spirits.description: A developed industrial base is constrained by missed targets, weak input balances and repeated plan extensions.
starting_spirits.remedy: Balance the Inputs removes this spirit after one substantive industrial priority and a funded project.

starting_spirits.title: Power and Imported Inputs
starting_spirits.description: Power shortages and imported machinery and fuel limit the use of installed industrial capacity.
starting_spirits.remedy: Repair the Power Grid removes the electricity/output component. Residual imported-input fuel burden remains until external resilience.

starting_spirits.title: An Uneven Civilian Supply
starting_spirits.description: Civilian supply competes with heavy industry and defence; rural inputs and urban distribution remain uneven.
starting_spirits.remedy: A Sustainable Ration removes this after both irrigation/fertilizer and county clinics. This is not the 1990s famine.

starting_spirits.title: Juche and the Two Patrons
starting_spirits.description: Political autonomy is defended through cautious access to foreign technology and competition between external patrons.
starting_spirits.remedy: External Channels replaces this with strategic autonomy: +6% influence defense / −3% trade opinion. Signed cooperation provides additional technical benefits.

news.title: Kim Il Sung Has Died
news.description: Pyongyang has announced the death of Kim Il Sung at the age of 82. Kim Jong Il has assumed the leadership of North Korea, ending the founder’s forty-six years in power.
news.alternative_description: Kim Il Sung, North Korea’s former leader, has died at the age of 82. His death closes the era of the Republic’s founding generation.
news.broadcast: One global major news event, visible to all countries.
news.succession: Install Kim Jong Il only if the incumbent Kim regime was in office immediately before the death. Alternative governments remain in office.
news.succession_guard: Record incumbent Kim Il Sung before his existing 1994.7.8 leader expiry; a one-time global receipt prevents duplicate death / succession events.
news.formal_titles: National leader from July 1994; not automatically President or WPK General Secretary in 1994.

availability_receipt.status: Proposed country lifecycle receipt, not an existing MD API.
availability_receipt.producer: Normally absent in the historical 1970–1994 course. Explicit RP mortality or permanent retirement of the successor must set it; family promotion and succession recheck it.

policy_lifecycle.party: Earned policies apply only under their registered governing party or institution; reconcile on government change, monthly maintenance and load. Return earned spirits without repeating one-time rewards.
policy_lifecycle.leader: Kim-family and Kim Jong Il policies also require their respective leader conditions. Kim Jong Il succession on 8 July 1994 replaces only the incumbent Kim regime.
policy_lifecycle.treaties: Signed bilateral agreements survive government changes. Suspend both copies and weekly fees together during mutual war or bilateral sanctions; resume without repeating setup grants.
policy_lifecycle.resubmission: Completed offer focuses unlock sender decisions to resubmit after refusal or expiry, with fresh quotes and a new 90-day response period. Only one offer per agreement/stage may be pending.

bootstrap_contract.scenario: Attach this tree and the six defined opening spirit packages in the guarded 1970 NKO startup. Existing 2000 add_ideas are not the 1970 starting package.
bootstrap_contract.guards: original_tag = NKO; IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes; existing governing-party variable. The monolithic starting policy is WPK-bound; the other five opening constraints are national.
bootstrap_contract.reconciliation: A one-time initialization receipt plus earned replacement receipts prevents duplicate startup or restoration of a removed opening constraint. Reconcile on load without rerunning buildings, cash or research grants.
bootstrap_contract.scope: No starting OOB, troops, ships, aircraft, uranium production or built uranium mines are added.

budget_contract.one_off: Current payer gdp_total × chosen share; no fixed-dollar floor.
budget_contract.quote: Save both countries’ GDP-based setup quotes when the offer is sent; charge exactly those saved amounts only on recipient acceptance.
budget_contract.weekly: Current payer GDP × annual commitment ÷ 52. Aggregate once in the native weekly expense system only while the paired agreement is active.
budget_contract.borrowing: Normal MD weekly automatic borrowing remains available; no added current-cash gate.
budget_contract.slots: Every building level grants the same number of extra shared slots in the same owned and controlled state; enforce non-slot caps and placement rules.
